subject: Separation & entry controls evidence — onboarding/offboarding package request
messages:
From: Laura Keyes <l.keyes@northbridge.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: security@northbridge.com
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: onboarding / separation control artifacts for SIG review

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking a look. As part of the SIG questionnaire validation for our procurement committee, we need a short package demonstrating Redwood's personnel controls for new hires and leavers. Specifically we need: 
- evidence that background checks are performed (sample redacted PDF is fine),
- training completion rosters for the past 12 months,
- the formal onboarding + offboarding control matrix and the runbook for access removal, and
- a point of contact for any follow-up.

Timeline: can you share items or a link by end of week (Dec 3)? If any items are not shareable, a short note explaining redaction or where the evidence lives is OK.

Appreciate it — Laura
Security & Risk, Northbridge Financial

Attachments: none
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding / separation control artifacts for SIG review

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Priyom (compliance) and Marissa (HR) — they will assemble the evidence and confirm what can be redacted. Jonas from ops will include the offboarding runbook and the control matrix.

Quick plan:
- Marissa: will pull the training roster CSV and a redacted BG check sample.
- Priyom: will prepare a short cover memo describing our background verification vendor and retention limits.
- Jonas: will export the onboarding/offboarding control matrix and the runbook, and note SLOs for access removal.

We should be able to provide a Drive folder link with the items and a brief index by Friday (Dec 3). If anything needs to be executed via Docusign (POA/attestation), we will flag it.

Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Laura Keyes <l.keyes@northbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding / separation control artifacts for SIG review — package uploaded

Hi all / Laura,

Package uploaded to shared Drive folder and indexed. Summary below.

What we provided (Drive link included in metadata):
1) training-roster-2026-2027.csv — training completion for security awareness, SaaS handling, and data classification for all full-time employees (redwood.com domain). PII redacted where applicable.
2) background-check-sample-redacted.pdf — single redacted report demonstrating the vendor checks used (criminal/court checks), redactions applied to candidate PII; retention statement included in the memo.
3) onboard-offboard-control-matrix.xlsx — mapping of entry/exit steps to system owners, timing, and required attestations.
4) offboarding-runbook-v2.md — step-by-step access removal checklist including ticket templates and IAM revoke scripts.
5) cover-memo-personnel-controls.pdf — short memo describing vendors, retention periods, and exception handling (SOC 2 scope note included).

Notes and caveats:
- Background check originals contain candidate SSNs and are not shareable; we produced a redacted sample and a signed attestation about retention and access controls.
- For contractors, screening scope differs slightly — matrix row 7 explains alignment and evidence for contingent workers.
- If you need CSV in a different format (by org or team), we can export before Friday EOD — tell us the preferred breakdown.

Next steps: Laura — please confirm receipt and whether you need narrative responses to any SIG/CAIQ questions; if so, point us to the question IDs and we'll map evidence to them.

Thanks — Priyom
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: training-roster-2026-2027.csv, background-check-sample-redacted.pdf, onboard-offboard-control-matrix.xlsx, offboarding-runbook-v2.md
From: Laura Keyes <l.keyes@northbridge.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding / separation control artifacts for SIG review — thanks, received

Kimberly / team — thank you, received the Drive folder and reviewed the index. Preliminary thumbs-up from our risk reviewer — the redacted BG sample and runbook cover what we need. A couple quick asks: 
- Can you provide a one-paragraph vendor attestation for the background-check provider with the contract start date? (we will include that in the SIG evidence bundle)
- We may ask for a CSV broken out by business unit (sales, product, ops) for the training roster; if you can pre-run that export it will speed our review.

If those are available early next week that would be great. Otherwise this is in good shape and we'll follow up with any SIG question IDs where we need mapping.

Best,
Laura
Security & Risk — Northbridge Financial
